# NeoStation iOS 0.0.7 🎮
*Build 455 · What's new since v0.0.6*

- **Nintendo 3DS moves to Azahar 2127.0-alpha1**, with **Fast Interpreter** mode and improved BIOS/NAND imports, including supported console-encrypted NAND titles.
- **AirPlay on Apple TV:** fixed how NeoStation menus are displayed.
- **Your menu, your choice:** hide all consoles or disable embedded emulators individually.
- **More ways to customize your games:** improved skin catalogs, new Libretro shaders and visual effects for Dolphin.
- **Adjustable internal resolution:** choose a resolution for each supported embedded Libretro core, or set it for an individual game.
- **Refined touch controls**, with improvements to on-screen buttons and virtual sticks.
- **A new menu soundtrack:** “Once Upon a Time (loop)” by TAD (CC0), enabled by default and easy to turn off in Settings.

📦 **Build 455 is available below.** Download **NeoStation-0.0.7.ipa** and install it with your usual sideloading tool.

[Third-party licenses and notices](https://github.com/TarbleFR/neostation-ios/releases/download/0.0.7/NeoStation-0.0.7-Licenses-and-Notices.zip) · [Updated guide](https://github.com/TarbleFR/neostation-ios/blob/Claude/README.md) · [License review and remaining questions](https://github.com/TarbleFR/neostation-ios/blob/Claude/docs/RELEASE_0.0.7_LICENSE_REVIEW.md)

The supplemental notices do not modify the Build 455 IPA. SHA-256 checksums for both downloads are included below.

Thanks for playing and for sharing your feedback!
